protocol:
1. Dispense an unspecified liquid into an open microcentrifuge/PCR tube using an adjustable micropipette; keep tubes and reagents adjacent to a green ice bucket.

2. Add an aliquot of liquid to a labeled microcentrifuge tube held on ice using a micropipette; no volume is visible.

3. Place the labeled tube into a yellow tube rack beside the ice bucket.

4. Add a second aliquot of liquid to the same labeled tube using a micropipette; no volume or reagent identity is visible.

5. Return the tube to the yellow rack and close the tube cap.

6. Place the capped tube into the Bio-Rad thermal cycler and close the heated lid; no cycling parameters are readable.

7. Retrieve another chilled tube from the ice bucket and place it into the yellow rack.

8. Add liquid to the chilled tube using an adjustable micropipette; no volume is visible.

9. Return the prepared tube to the rack.

10. Hold an agar plate and dispense liquid sample onto the agar surface using a micropipette; no volume or medium composition is visible.

11. Spread the dispensed liquid across the agar surface with the pipette tip.

12. Set the inoculated agar plate on the bench with its lid nearby.
